stem: Two cubes of masses m₁ and m₂ lie on frictionless slopes of a block A which rests on a horizontal table. The cubes are connected by a string which passes over a pulley as shown in figure (m₂ on the upper face inclined at β, sloping down towards the pulley; m₁ on the outer face inclined at α). If a be the horizontal acceleration (towards the pulley side, as shown) to which the whole system (block + masses) is subjected, so that m₁ and m₂ do not move relative to A, then find a.
book_key: a = [(m 1 sinα + m 2 sinβ) / (m 1 cosα + m 2 cosβ)] g
